description: Parking Expiations Issued by Adelaide City Council is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Adelaide. This dataset includes all parking expiations issued by the Adelaide City Council, and includes data such as payments, current status and exemptions for all parking expiations issued during the last three years. The dataset is refreshed on the 6th day of every month and includes data up to the end of the previous month. Coverage: City of Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher City of Adelaide. Its tags are adelaide, adelaide city council, car parking, expiations, fines. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
